title: Configuration bound under logarithmic space
statement:
Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $c,n\in\mathbb{N}$. Define $L(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ and $B_M(n,s)=(|Q|+1)(n+2)3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k$. Then
\[
B_M\bigl(n,cL(n)\bigr)\le (|Q|+1)\,2\,2^{5kc+3k}(n+1)^{5kc+1}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
